data.one_liner: Injection system and routes for flutter_modular and shelf_modular
data.what_it_does: Provides core injection system and route management capabilities primarily used by flutter_modular and shelf_modular. It handles dependency binding, module imports, and route resolution.
use_when: You are building applications using flutter_modular
You need modular route management and dependency injection
avoid_when: You are looking for a standalone dependency injection container without flutter_modular
You prefer standard Flutter navigation and routing
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with flutter_modular and shelf_modular
Supports module-based scoping and dependency binding
weaknesses: Primarily designed as an internal core package for modular frameworks rather than direct standalone usage
Limited documentation outside of its parent ecosystem

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a standalone service locator and dependency injection tool without modular routing constraints.

alternatives.name: injectable
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer code-generation-based dependency injection on top of get_it.
